summary: AdMob removal verified end-to-end. Repo grep for 'google-mobile-ads', 'AdMob', 'ADMOB', 'ads.native', 'ads.web', 'useCompletionInterstitial' across /app/frontend/app, /app/frontend/src, /app/frontend/app.json, /app/frontend/.env and /app/frontend/package.json returned ZERO hits. Files src/lib/ads.native.ts, ads.web.ts and ads.d.ts are absent (src/lib now only contains api/plant/push/revenuecat/screenLock/sessionNotifications/theme). app.json is valid JSON with expo-camera as the last plugin (google-mobile-ads plugin entry gone). Metro compiles clean and all 5 bottom tabs (Tree/Goals/Focus/Friends/Profile) render. 1-min custom session completes and shows session-recap-screen with recap-xp=+2, recap-minutes=1, recap-streak=🔥 1, recap-today=2; recap-close-button dismisses cleanly and the timer screen stays interactive with no black screen. Locked-in mode overlay (focus-locked-screen) appears immediately when a locked session starts, and the give-up flow (give-up-button → give-up-confirm-button → focus-lock-death-modal 'Oakley II died') works. Profile pro-features-card lists exactly 4 benefits: Monthly streak freeze (with freeze-count testID), Free tree revives, Golden PRO badge, Early access to new features — NO 'No ads' item. Paywall PERKS array has 4 non-ad perks. Settings sheet PRO row subtitle for non-PRO reads 'Monthly freezes, revives + golden badge' as required, and settings rows notifications-switch, focus-lock-switch, strict-lock-switch, manage-pro-button, delete-account-row all render. Friends tab renders friends-screen, my-qr-card, friend-code-pill, scan-qr-button, friend-code-input, send-request-button, leaderboard-card, leaderboard-row-1/2. No red screen or module-resolution errors observed. Only console noise was one stale 401 before the token was hydrated (expected) and RN web 'shadow*' deprecation warnings unrelated to this change.
critical_code_review_comments: expo-doctor warns expo@54.0.36 (expected ~54.0.37) and expo-constants@18.0.13 (expected ~18.0.14) — cosmetic, unrelated to ad removal, worth bumping when convenient.
